sources.title: The AI Act — Retorio
sources.quote: Yes, Retorio is 100% AI Act compliant. It uses neither biometric data to recognize individuals nor is it an “emotion recognition system”, as the law calls it.

sources.title: Is Retorio doing emotion recognition?
sources.quote: The AI only checks facial expressions, such as a smile. The legal text explicitly distinguishes between emotion recognition systems and unproblematic behavior recognition.

sources.title: What problems does Retorio actually solve?
sources.quote: Retorio is used in HR to support companies in the selection and development of employees.
